title: Group — shared definitions for the vtc/groups/* spec family
description:
A Verifiable Trust Community's community groups: named sets of members that administrators (and the group managers they appoint) run. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

EVERY GROUP HAS ITS OWN DID. The community's own VTA mints it from a DID template and holds its keys; the community never does. Where the group issues credentials (`issuesCredentials`, default true), the community issues the group an authorization credential naming it a membership issuer, and the group's DID issues each member a short-lived membership credential, renewed for as long as they stay. A verifier chains member's group credential → group's authorization credential → community.

GROUPS PROVISION; THE ACCESS-CONTROL LIST AUTHORISES. A group never answers an authorization question at the community. Authority a group carries (a `grants` or `role` binding) is written into each member's access-control entry as a resource grant whose source is the group, and removed when they leave. A group's membership credential is evidence for others — rooms, peers, other communities — and is never consulted by the community's own authorization.

MEMBERSHIP IS KEYED BY ENTRY. Members are directory entries (`EntryId`), so membership survives a rotation of the member's DID, and departure from the community removes it.

GroupId.title: GroupId
GroupId.description: Opaque identifier of a community group: `grp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and community-scoped; not the group's DID.

GroupName.title: GroupName
GroupName.description: The group's name, shown to those who may see the group. The community's own record: never in the group's DID document or its credentials' subject beyond the group's DID. Plain text.

GroupDescription.title: GroupDescription
GroupDescription.description: What the group is for. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions. Same placement rules as `GroupName`.

GroupAudience.title: GroupAudience
GroupAudience.description: Who may see something about a group, narrowest first. `admins`: holders of `vtc.groups.manage` for the group (unqualified, or qualified `group:<groupId>`). `groupMembers`: the group's own members, and its managers. `members`: every active member of the community.

GroupKind.title: GroupKind
GroupKind.description: `static`: membership is explicit — added, joined, or granted on request. `dynamic`: membership is computed from `rule` over verified facts only; nobody is added by hand, but a member may opt out (vtc/groups/leave), an exclusion the rule cannot override, and undo it (vtc/groups/join). A dynamic group never confers authority. Fixed for the group's life.

JoinPolicy.title: JoinPolicy
JoinPolicy.description: How a member enters a static group by themselves. `closed`: only a manager adds them. `request`: a member asks and a manager decides. `open`: a member joins at once, subject to the community's `groups` policy. A group carrying authority is always `closed`.

RuleCondition.title: RuleCondition
RuleCondition.description: One test over a verified fact about a member. `fact: role` tests the member's community role; `fact: field` tests an `admin`- or `credential`-sourced directory field named by `field`; `fact: personhood` tests whether a personhood assertion is on file; `fact: joinedAt` tests when they joined. A rule never reads a self-asserted (`member`-sourced) field: a member must not be able to join a group by editing their card.

op.description: `equals` compares with `value`; `oneOf` with any of `values`; `exists` needs neither; `before` and `after` compare a date fact with `value`.

DynamicRule.title: DynamicRule
DynamicRule.description: A dynamic group's membership rule: a member belongs when every condition holds and they have not opted out. The community evaluates it under its `groups` policy and recomputes membership whenever a fact it reads changes, always excluding opted-out entries.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: A community group, as a caller who may see it sees it. Members a caller may not see are absent: `memberCount` only to those who may see the group's members, `managers` and `credentialAuthorityValidUntil` only to its managers.

groupDid.description: The group's own DID, minted by the community's VTA for this group alone. It issues the group's membership credentials. Its DID document carries no name or description.

visibility.description: Who may see that the group exists, and its name and description.

showMembers.description: Who may see the group's member list. Separate from `visibility`: a group everyone sees may show its members only to administrators. Never wider than `visibility`.

issuesCredentials.description: Whether the group's DID issues its members a membership credential. Default true.

carriesAuthority.description: `true` while the group has a `grants` or `role` binding. Such a group is `static` and `closed` for as long as it does.

memberCount.description: Active members. Only to callers who may see the member list.

managers.description: Entries holding `vtc.groups.manage` qualified to this group, read from the access-control list. Informational: managers are appointed by an access-control grant, never by this record.

credentialAuthorityValidUntil.description: When the community's authorization credential to the group expires. The community renews it well before.

createdBy.description: The creating administrator's directory entry, where they have one.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. An extension member MUST NOT carry authority.

MembershipSource.title: MembershipSource
MembershipSource.description: How the member came to be in the group. `added`: by a manager. `joined`: they joined an open group. `requestApproved`: a manager approved their request. `rule`: a dynamic group's rule admits them.

state.description: `active`: a member. `pending`: an addition to a group carrying authority that is waiting for the consent the community requires for a grant.

fields.description: The member's directory fields that the caller may see, projected exactly as vtc/directory/entries/show would project them. Absent when the caller may see none.

credentialId.description: The member's current group membership credential, or null when the group issues none.

credentialValidUntil.description: When the member's current group credential expires. Shown to the member themselves and to managers only.

JoinRequestMessage.title: JoinRequestMessage
JoinRequestMessage.description: An optional note from the member to the group's managers. Plain text.

decidedBy.description: The manager who decided. Shown to managers only.

RoomBindingSpec.title: RoomBindingSpec
RoomBindingSpec.description: Links a room the community owns to the group: joining the group offers the member admission to the room with `actions`, valid for `validFor`; leaving removes them unless another source still covers them.

validFor.description: How long each admission's authority runs, as an ISO 8601 duration in whole days (`P365D`). The community renews it while the member stays in the group.

GrantsBindingSpec.title: GrantsBindingSpec
GrantsBindingSpec.description: A grant set the group confers: each capability is written onto every member's access-control entry as a resource grant whose source is the group, bounded by the member's role ceiling and by the binder's own holdings.

RoleBindingSpec.title: RoleBindingSpec
RoleBindingSpec.description: A grant set by reference: the capability ceiling of a defined role, conferred as resource grants exactly as a `grants` binding confers its list. It never assigns the role itself — an entry's administrative role and its community role stay direct assignments.

state.description: `pending`: waiting for the consent the community requires. `active`: in force; the community's reconciler keeps members' admissions and grants in line with it. `removing`: being withdrawn; the reconciler is removing what only this binding provided.

GroupCredentialId.title: GroupCredentialId
GroupCredentialId.description: Identifier (`id`) of a group membership credential issued to a member. Each renewal issues a new credential with a new identifier. Validity is the community's setting; a community SHOULD default to 30 days, renewed when 10 days remain.
